title: Writing across disciplines: UI is in elite company
summary_en: Iowa’s unmatched writing-related resources prepare its graduates for success in many fields. This level of excellence, strengthened in the past year by the creation of the Office of Writing and Communication and piloting a new undergraduate curriculum, positions Iowa as the best public university for writing and communication.
title_cn: Writing across disciplines: UI is in elite company

title: Fall cohort brings new vision to UI’s International Writing Program
summary_en: Nearly 60 years after its founding, the International Writing Program begins another chapter supported by donors, longtime partners, and the Iowa City community. This fall’s cohort of 22 residents will help guide the program’s future and continue its tradition of bringing writers together across borders.
title_cn: Fall cohort brings new vision to UI’s International Writing Program

title: Ferentz family's neonatal research gift continues to give hope to preemies
summary_en: Iowa head football coach Kirk Ferentz and his wife, Mary, continue to support neonatal research at UI Stead Family Children’s Hospital in memory of their granddaughter Savvy. Their support is helping improve outcomes for the hospital’s tiniest patients. Read about the Savvy Ferentz Program in Neonatal Research and how you can support its work.
title_cn: Ferentz family's neonatal research gift continues to give hope to preemies
